editComposer.title: Edit with AI
panel.placeholderAllDocuments: Ask or instruct using every document in this workspace…
panel.placeholderCollection: Ask or instruct using the collection…
panel.emptyIntro: Ask for changes to this document — “tighten the opening paragraph”, “add a summary at the top”, “turn the notes at the end into a table”.
panel.emptyAuto: AI edits to this document apply directly: they land when a turn ends, recorded and revertible. This chat is private.
panel.emptyReview: Every edit appears in the document as a suggestion you accept or reject there. This chat is private: only edits you accept reach version history.
panel.revisionPaused: {count, plural, one {Revision paused} other {Revision paused · # requests}}
panel.revisionQueued: {count, plural, one {Revision queued} other {Revision queued · # requests}}
panel.attachImageTooltip: Attach an image (or paste / drop one here)
setup.title: AI chat is off
setup.askAdmin: Ask your administrator to turn it on, or connect your own AI agent.
transcript.stagedInDocument: {count, plural, one {Proposed # change — review it in the document.} other {Proposed # changes — review them in the document.}}
transcript.stagedInGrid: {count, plural, one {Proposed # change — review it in the banner above the grid.} other {Proposed # changes — review them in the banner above the grid.}}
transcript.crossDocApplied: {count, plural, one {Applied # change in “{title}”.} other {Applied # changes in “{title}”.}}
transcript.crossDocProposed: {count, plural, one {Proposed # change in “{title}” — open it to review.} other {Proposed # changes in “{title}” — open it to review.}}
transcript.crossDocLocked: Couldn’t propose changes in “{title}”: it is locked.
transcript.crossDocNoAccess: Couldn’t propose changes in “{title}”: this conversation can’t edit it.
transcript.crossDocNotFound: Couldn’t propose changes in “{title}”: it is no longer available.
transcript.crossDocTooLarge: Couldn’t propose changes in “{title}”: the result would be too large for one document.
transcript.crossDocStale: Couldn’t propose changes in “{title}”: it changed while the AI was writing.
transcript.crossDocLedgerUnavailable: Couldn’t propose changes in “{title}”: its edit ledger is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
transcript.crossDocUnreachable: Couldn’t reach “{title}”, so no changes were proposed there.
citation.label: Citation
citation.pendingTitle: Source appears when the answer finishes
notice.askMaxRounds: I stopped after the maximum number of research steps — ask a follow-up to continue.
notice.askBudget: The AI budget ran out part-way through the answer.
notice.askFailed: Something failed part-way through; this answer may be incomplete.
notice.askDegraded: Semantic search was unavailable, so this matched words only. Results may be less relevant.
notice.maxRounds: Stopped after {count, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}} of work. Ask me to continue if there’s more to do.
notice.endedEarlyStaged: The turn ended early, but the changes above are staged for review.
notice.endedEarlyApplied: The turn ended early, but the changes above were applied.
notice.stoppedStaged: Stopped. The changes it had already made are staged for review.
notice.stoppedApplied: Stopped. The changes it had already made were applied.
notice.imageLeftLinked: Couldn’t download {url} ({reason}), so its link was left as-is.
notice.imagesTruncated: {count, plural, one {Only the first # image was downloaded; the rest kept their original links.} other {Only the first # images were downloaded; the rest kept their original links.}}
failure.quota: The AI provider says the account is out of credit. An administrator can check Settings → This node → AI providers.
failure.auth: The AI provider did not accept this node’s key. An administrator can check Settings → This node → AI providers.
failure.rateLimit: The AI provider is limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
failure.unavailable: The AI provider is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
error.locked: This document is locked; unlock it to make changes.
error.viewOnly: You have view-only access to this document.
error.rateLimited: Too many AI requests; try again shortly.
error.unreadable: The request could not be read.
error.emptyPrompt: Say what you’d like me to do.
error.agent: Agents use the MCP tools, not the in-app co-author.
error.proposeLocked: This document was locked before the changes could be proposed, so nothing was staged.
error.tooLarge: The result would be too large for one document, so nothing was staged.
error.ledgerUnavailable: This document’s edit ledger is temporarily unavailable — nothing was staged. Try again shortly.
error.stale: The document changed while the AI was writing, so its changes no longer applied.
error.reviewBacklog: {count, plural, one {This document already has # proposal waiting for review. Decide on it before asking for more changes.} other {This document already has # proposals waiting for review. Decide on some before asking for more changes.}}
threads.empty: Your questions will be saved here.
threads.deleteDescription: The answers and their sources are deleted with it. The documents themselves are not affected.
trace.searched: {hits, plural, one {Searched for “{query}” — # result} other {Searched for “{query}” — # results}}
trace.listed: {count, plural, one {Looked through # document} other {Looked through # documents}}
trace.listedMatching: {count, plural, one {Looked through # document matching “{query}”} other {Looked through # documents matching “{query}”}}
trace.listedWithFolders: {count, plural, one {Looked through # document and {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}} other {Looked through # documents and {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}}}
trace.listedWithFoldersMatching: {count, plural, one {Looked through # document and {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}} matching “{query}”} other {Looked through # documents and {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}} matching “{query}”}}
